articles.title: Trump Makes a Deal to Get Diesel Fuel From Russia
articles.summary: President Trump made a deal to buy Russian diesel to help lower US fuel prices, but Ukraine's leader and some experts criticized it.

articles.title: Judge Navi Pillay Wins the Nobel Peace Prize
articles.summary: South African judge Navi Pillay won the Nobel Peace Prize for her long work in world courts protecting human rights.

articles.title: How Election Workers Make Sure Votes Are Counted Right
articles.summary: Election workers in Utah test counting machines with practice ballots and carefully track every mail ballot to make sure votes are counted correctly.
